                after_tokens BIGINT, round_index BIGINT, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (session_id, compact_seq)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_usage_rounds (
                session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, send_index BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                round_index BIGINT NOT NULL, prompt_tokens BIGINT,
                completion_tokens BIGINT, total_tokens BIGINT, cached_tokens BIGINT, model VARCHAR(255),
                created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (session_id, send_index, round_index)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_session_state (
                session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, next_seq BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                round_index BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_compact_seq BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                pending_json LONGTEXT, PRIMARY KEY (session_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_session_runtime_state (
                session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, state_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, value_json LONGTEXT,
                updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id, state_key)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_shared_state (
                owner VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, state_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, value_json LONGTEXT,
                updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (owner, state_key)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_background_tasks (
                session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, task_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, command LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
                status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, return_code BIGINT, output_tail LONGTEXT, output_path LONGTEXT,
                last_seen_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
                updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id, task_id),
                KEY fixture_idx_background_tasks_session_status (session_id, status, updated_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_session_stats (
                session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, sends BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                rounds BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, llm_calls BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                tool_calls BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, prompt_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                completion_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, total_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                cached_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                first_send_at BIGINT, last_send_at BIGINT, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (session_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_timers (
                session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, timer_id BIGINT NOT NULL, due_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
                note LONGTEXT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'armed', interval_s BIGINT,
                fire_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_fired_at BIGINT,
                created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (session_id, timer_id),
                KEY fixture_idx_timers_due (status, due_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_notes (
                session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, note_id BIGINT NOT NULL, content LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
                pinned TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
                updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id, note_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_project_messages (
                id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, send_index BIGINT NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                content_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL, rendered_text LONGTEXT,
                source_seq_lo BIGINT, source_seq_hi BIGINT,
                compact_from_send BIGINT, compact_to_send BIGINT,
                projector_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, token_estimate BIGINT,
                created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY (session_id, send_index, kind),
                KEY fixture_idx_project_messages_session_kind (session_id, kind, send_index)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_hook_events (
                session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, event_id BIGINT NOT NULL, message_seq BIGINT,
                round_index BIGINT, send_index BIGINT, hook_point VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, hook VARCHAR(255),
                position VARCHAR(32), kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, payload_json LONGTEXT, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (session_id, event_id),
                KEY fixture_idx_hook_events_session_msg (session_id, message_seq)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_session_leases (
                session_id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, owner_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                acquired_at BIGINT NOT NULL, expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
                fence BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_follow_up_queue (
                id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, item_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queue',
                status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', content LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
                meta_json LONGTEXT, claim_token VARCHAR(64), claimed_at BIGINT,
                created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, delivered_at BIGINT, delivered_seq BIGINT,
                delivered_send_index BIGINT,
                UNIQUE KEY fixture_uq_inbox_item (session_id, item_id),
                KEY fixture_idx_inbox_session_status (session_id, status, id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_context_cache (
            cache_key VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, executor_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            owner_session_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
            payload_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL, summary LONGTEXT, result_hash VARCHAR(64),
            lease_token VARCHAR(64), lease_until BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, accessed_at BIGINT NOT NULL, expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
            size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            retry_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, INDEX fixture_context_due (executor_key,status,retry_at,created_at), INDEX fixture_context_running (status,lease_until), INDEX fixture_context_lru (status,accessed_at), INDEX fixture_idx_context_capacity (size_bytes))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_context_attempts (
            attempt_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, cache_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            owner_session_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, outcome VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
            record_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL, delivered INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            accounted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, INDEX fixture_context_outbox (accounted,delivered,created_at), INDEX fixture_context_attempt_key (cache_key,outcome), INDEX fixture_context_attempt_owner (owner_session_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_task_store (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, store_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, protocol_version INTEGER NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_jobs (
            job_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, parent_job_id VARCHAR(64), root_job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            parent_generation BIGINT, parent_executor_id VARCHAR(64), parent_boot_id VARCHAR(64),
            control_owner_job_id VARCHAR(64), control_owner_generation BIGINT,
            control_owner_executor_id VARCHAR(64), control_owner_boot_id VARCHAR(64),
            tenant_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, principal_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
            session_id VARCHAR(255), created_by_session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
            kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, execution_role VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, title LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
            completion_scope_job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, blocks_completion INTEGER NOT NULL,
            status VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, version BIGINT NOT NULL, generation BIGINT NOT NULL,
            executor_id VARCHAR(64), boot_id VARCHAR(64), executor_key VARCHAR(64), lease_until_ms BIGINT,
            cancel_requested_at BIGINT, cancel_reason LONGTEXT,
            intake VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, resource_state VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            supervision_status VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, result_status VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            outcome VARCHAR(64), result_json LONGTEXT,
            created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_job_events (
            event_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            event_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, job_version BIGINT NOT NULL,
            operation_key VARCHAR(64) UNIQUE, request_hash VARCHAR(64), action VARCHAR(64),
            caller_session_id VARCHAR(255), tool_call_id VARCHAR(255), call_ref_json LONGTEXT,
            receipt_ref_json LONGTEXT, payload_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
            delivery_status VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_task_executors (
            executor_key VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, principal_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
            executor_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, boot_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, contract_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            state VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, version BIGINT NOT NULL, lease_until_ms BIGINT NOT NULL,
            created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_task_executor_events (
            event_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, executor_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, action VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            operation_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            payload_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_task_budget_policies (
            policy_key VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, principal_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
            request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, manifest_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,
            created_at BIGINT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_task_budget_scopes (
            scope_key VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, policy_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            limits_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, limits_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL, counters_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, counters_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixture_task_budget_attempts (
            attempt_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, policy_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            version BIGINT NOT NULL, phase VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, pending INTEGER NOT NULL,
            state_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, state_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
CREATE INDEX fixture_idx_jobs_root_page ON fixture_jobs(root_job_id,job_id)
